info.name: NapsterAI API
info.description:
ASP.NET Core API wrapping the Napster Companion/Agent platform (https://developers.napster.com/docs/introduction/quickstart).

Covers: browsing stock companions, creating agents, creating live connections, listing past sessions, and managing knowledge bases/FAQ collections - plus a few requests that intentionally trigger this API's validation/error-handling paths (400/404/409/502).

Set the `baseUrl` collection variable (defaults to the local dev server) before running requests. No auth is needed on these requests themselves - the Napster API key lives server-side in this app's own configuration (Napster:ApiKey via user-secrets or an environment variable), never in the client calling this API.

query.description: Free-text filter on companion name, disabled if empty

request.description: Browses Napster's stock AI companion personas. Maps to GET /public/companions/napster-stock upstream.
Same endpoint, showing the search filter in use. Save one of the returned `items[].id` values into the `companionId` collection variable to use in the other folders.

Creates a reusable agent configuration bound to a companion. Maps to POST /public/agents upstream. `providerSettings` is passed through as raw JSON - see https://developers.napster.com/docs/api-reference/agents/post for its full shape.

Note: `voiceId` is documented as optional but Napster's own validation rejects agent creation without one (confirmed live: 400 "Voice id is required.") - this API validates that client-side too, so leaving it out here returns a 400 before ever calling Napster.

Note: the VALUE of voiceId is provider-specific and unvalidated by both Napster and this API - a value from the wrong TTS engine (e.g. an Azure Speech name against an OpenAI-backed companion) still returns 200/201 here, but the live SDK session then fails with "Invalid voice provided". `alloy` (a standard OpenAI voice) is used here since the companions tested against defaulted to OpenAI - if your session rejects it, decode the token from Create Connection (base64 JSON) and check avatar.voices[].provider to find the actual engine.

Creates a live (WebRTC/WebSocket) session token a client uses to talk to a companion directly. Maps to POST /public/connections upstream. `providerConfig` is passed through as raw JSON - see https://developers.napster.com/docs/api-reference/connections/post for its full shape.

Note: `providerConfig.voiceId` isn't documented for this endpoint at all, but Napster's own validation rejects connection creation without it (confirmed live: 400 "Voice id is required.") - this API validates that client-side too, so omitting it here returns a 400 before ever calling Napster.

Note: the VALUE of voiceId is provider-specific and unvalidated by both Napster and this API - a value from the wrong TTS engine still returns 200 here, but the live SDK session then fails at connect time with "Invalid voice provided". `alloy` (a standard OpenAI voice) is used here since the companions tested against defaulted to OpenAI - if your session rejects it, decode this response's `token` (base64 JSON) and check avatar.voices[].provider to find the actual engine.

query.description: One of: voip, sip, webrtc, websocket, kiosk

request.description: Lists past conversation sessions/transcripts. Maps to GET /public/sessions upstream.
Same endpoint, filtered to a specific companion's WebRTC sessions.

query.description: One of: azureOpenAI, gemini, openAI, humain, microsoftFoundry

request.description: Lists knowledge bases - containers of reference documents an agent can be pointed at. Maps to GET /public/knowledge-bases upstream.

Creates a new, initially empty knowledge base. Maps to POST /public/knowledge-bases upstream. `provider` defaults to azureOpenAI if omitted; use this knowledge base's returned `id` as `knowledgeBaseId` on Create Agent to attach it.
Lists FAQ collections - named sets of question/answer pairs an agent can be pointed at. Maps to GET /public/faqs upstream.

Creates a new FAQ collection, optionally pre-populated with question/answer pairs. Maps to POST /public/faqs upstream. Save the returned `id` into the `faqCollectionId` collection variable to use with List FAQ Items, or as an entry in `faqCollections` on Create Agent.
Lists the question/answer items in one FAQ collection. Maps to GET /public/faqs/{faqCollectionId}/items upstream.

Logs in with the dev-seed Admin account and stores the returned accessToken/refreshToken as collection variables, used as the Bearer token by every AgentOrAdmin/AdminOnly request below. Rate-limited (policy "login").
Logs in with the dev-seed Agent account instead of Admin - useful for exercising AgentOrAdmin-only endpoints and confirming AdminOnly ones correctly 403 for this role.
Exchanges the stored refreshToken for a new access/refresh token pair (rotated on every use - the old refreshToken stops working immediately after this call).

item.name: Real Estate - EdgeMCP Tools
item.description: Backend-only QA surface for the 7 EdgeMCP tools registered on document.modelContext by src/NapsterAI.RealEstate.Web/src/lib/edge-mcp/registerRealEstateTools.ts (Phase 9). Each request here hits the exact endpoint + shape the tool's execute() calls, bypassing the AI loop entirely - use this to verify a tool's underlying call works before debugging it through a live chat session. All anonymous (no Authorization header) - these are the same public, visitor-privilege endpoints the site itself calls.

request.description: Tool: searchInventory (readOnly). The tool's own execute() first resolves a city to project ids via GET /realestate/projects when no projectId is given (GET /inventory has no city filter) and fans out per project - this request shows the single-project case that fan-out ultimately calls.
Tool: getProjectDetails (readOnly). The tool also fetches GET /projects/{id}/amenities in parallel and merges it into the result - see 'Get Project Amenities' in the Projects folder for that half.
Tool: calculatePaymentPlan (readOnly, idempotent). 404s if the unit's project has no payment-plan milestones configured yet - see Real Estate - Projects > Add Payment Plan Milestone.
Tool: bookViewing (destructive - the bridge should confirm with the user before calling this). Transactionally upserts Customer + Lead + Viewing.

Tool: createLead (destructive). Maps to POST /inquiries with channel fixed to "AI Assistant" so leads sourced from chat are distinguishable from the public "Request info" form (channel "Website") in admin reporting.

body.raw:
{
  "customerName": "Imran Qureshi",
  "customerEmail": "imran.q@example.com",
  "customerPhone": "+971-55-1231234",
  "projectId": 1,
  "message": "Interested in a 2BR in Dubai Marina, budget up to 2M AED.",
  "channel": "AI Assistant"
}

pageSize is validated client-side (1-100) before any call to Napster - expect a 400 ProblemDetails response.
gender must be one of male/female/nonBinary - expect a 400 ProblemDetails response.
companionId and providerSettings are required - expect a 400 ProblemDetails response.

voiceId is documented as optional but is actually required - Napster itself returns 400 "Voice id is required." for this, and this API now checks it client-side too, so expect a 400 ProblemDetails response before any call reaches Napster.
companionId is required - expect a 400 ProblemDetails response.

providerConfig.voiceId isn't documented for this endpoint at all, but is actually required - Napster itself returns 400 "Voice id is required." for this, and this API now checks it client-side too, so expect a 400 ProblemDetails response before any call reaches Napster.
sessionType must be one of voip/sip/webrtc/websocket/kiosk - expect a 400 ProblemDetails response.
If Napster:ApiKey is missing/invalid on the server, Napster returns 401 and this API maps it to a 502 ProblemDetails response explaining the credentials problem.
name is required - expect a 400 ProblemDetails response.

item.name: 400 - Create FAQ Collection with incomplete item

request.description: Each entry in faqs must have a non-empty question and answer - expect a 400 ProblemDetails response.
projectType must be one of Residential/Commercial/Mixed-Use/Villa/Retail - expect a 400 ProblemDetails response, validated before any database write.
No project with this id exists - expect a 404 ProblemDetails response.
PRJ-001 already exists in the dev seed data - expect a 409 ProblemDetails response.
sortBy must be one of price/area/listingDate - expect a 400 ProblemDetails response.

unitTypeId 5 belongs to a different project than projectId 1 in the dev seed data - expect a 400 ProblemDetails response, since Inventory has no direct FK-enforced cross-check and this is validated in the service layer instead.
Leads is AgentOrAdmin end-to-end (customer PII, no anonymous reads) - calling it with no Authorization header returns 401 Unauthorized.

Creating an organization is AdminOnly. Run Auth > Login (Agent) first, then call this - an Agent-role token is accepted (401 would mean no/invalid token) but rejected by the AdminOnly policy, so this returns 403 Forbidden.
RealEstateInventoryService throws RealEstateResourceNotFoundException when the id doesn't exist -> 404 ProblemDetails.
RealEstateUnitTypeService.FindAsync throws RealEstateResourceNotFoundException when the id doesn't exist -> 404 ProblemDetails.
